gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-sulphur-point: Commanding Wallpoet takes every bend in one smooth sweep, with lowercase that rises high and gaps where paper shows through. And Sulphur Point carries a marker-like line weight, so paragraphs move along steadily without tiring the eye.
gen-irish-grover-gf-ubuntu-sans: Fun and organic, Irish Grover makes words look large and sturdy, its strokes shifting softly like a pressed brush. Ubuntu Sans does the opposite job, with big lowercase eyes and tubular copper-pipe strokes that hold a steady outline.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-cascadia-mono: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke at a single width, giving a vintage, eye-catching headline with generous side spacing. Cascadia Mono adds compact, pin-straight letters, so the showy top line and the tidy text below never compete.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One reads wide and spacious, every curve left open-ended. Vast Shadow shouts in vintage, eye-catching single-width strokes, and the quiet text below lets the eye rest afterward.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-lexend-peta: Retro flash up top, big friendly text right underneath. Vast Shadow supplies the vintage, eye-catching lettering, while Lexend Peta brings curves that never thin out and a big x-height.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta spaces out its ribbon-like, constant-width strokes. Vast Shadow brings vintage, eye-catching drama, and what stands out is the way that loud lettering meets such wide, tidy text.
gen-vast-shadow-switzer: Switzer is built for steady text, its wire-like letters keeping c tips well apart. And Vast Shadow handles the loud part, vintage and eye-catching, every stroke cut at a single width.
gen-zen-dots-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans makes words look big and solid, its e opening clearly to the right. Merriweather Sans gives Zen Dots, with its friendly, techy letters and generous openings, a grounded partner to lean against.
gen-zen-dots-fs-public-sans: Friendly Zen Dots gives every letter shape lots of room, openings staying generous at any weight. Public Sans brings a hefty lowercase and broad counters, leaving Zen Dots to do its best work big and brief.
gen-almendra-display-fs-rowan: Ornate Almendra Display never pinches a letter shut, its x-height pronounced. Rowan does the quieter job, with generous openings in every curve and thin strokes about half the weight of thick ones.
